name: devin-honcho
description: Persistent cross-session memory for Devin CLI, powered by Honcho — lifecycle hooks capture your turns and recall context at session start

setup.notice: Requires a Honcho API key (or self-hosted Honcho) and Node >= 18 on your PATH. Configuration is shared with the other Honcho integrations via ~/.honcho/config.json.
steps: Run `honcho init` to save your API key, or reuse the existing ~/.honcho/config.json from another Honcho integration
Run `node bin/devin-honcho.mjs install` from this directory to seed hosts.devin and stage the hooks
Install the plugin with `devin plugins install --local <this directory>`, then start a new session
